company.name: Life Insurance Corporation (Nepal) Limited
company.mergerHistory: No merger; incorporated December 2000, licensed and operating since 2001.
company.about: LIC Nepal is a Nepal-based life insurer, incorporated in 2000 and operating since 2001, with Life Insurance Corporation of India as its largest shareholder. It is listed on NEPSE and sells endowment, money-back, child and micro life plans through agents across the country.
highlights: Over 6.9 lakh policies sold up to FY 2079/80 per press reports
Wide plan range including child, money-back and micro plans
company.claimSettlementNote: FY 2081/82, by amount: claims paid / (claims paid + claims outstanding), derived by Beema Portal from NIA Annual Report FY 2081/82 schedules 14-15 (NIA publishes no per-company ratio; year-end snapshot, excludes rejected claims). Third-party derived estimate.

policies.name: Endowment Plan
policies.summary: A savings plan that pays a lump sum at the end of the term, or to your family if you pass away earlier.
features: Fixed term savings with life cover
Yearly bonus declared on the sum assured
Loan facility against the policy after it gains surrender value
benefits: Death benefit: sum assured plus accrued bonus
Maturity benefit: sum assured plus accrued bonus
exclusions: Suicide within the first policy year
Death due to concealed or false information
bestFor: Salaried people saving steadily for 15-20 years

policies.name: Money Back Plan
policies.summary: Pays you part of the sum assured at set intervals during the term, with life cover throughout.
features: Life cover continues for the full term
benefits: Survival benefits at fixed points in the term
Death benefit: full sum assured plus bonus
Maturity benefit: remaining sum plus bonus
exclusions: Suicide within the first policy year
bestFor: Families wanting money back for milestones like education or a home

policies.name: Baal Unnati (Child Plan)
policies.summary: A plan for a parent to build funds for a child's education and future, with cover on the parent.
features: Built around a child's future needs
Covers both the child and the parent proposer
Optional disability rider for the proposer
benefits: Death benefit on the parent's life
exclusions: Suicide within the first policy year
bestFor: New parents planning for school and college costs

policies.name: Jeevan Anand
policies.summary: An endowment-plus-whole-life plan that pays the sum assured with bonus at the end of the premium term and keeps life cover until death.
features: Premium paid over a limited period
benefits: Death benefit: sum assured plus bonus
Maturity benefit: sum assured plus bonus
exclusions: Suicide within the first policy year
bestFor: Younger buyers wanting low-cost long-term cover with savings

policies.name: Term Micro Insurance
policies.summary: Low-cost pure protection that pays your family only if you die during the term.
features: Small sum assured aimed at lower-income households
benefits: Death benefit: sum assured to nominee
exclusions: Suicide within the first policy year
